traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are implemented and verified:
- **Before/After/Mixed JSDoc Tags**: Implemented in `processCommentLine` using `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine`, with dedicated tests covering traceability before, after, and interleaved with @param/@returns. - **Proper Termination & Tag Detection**: JSDoc tag lines (any `@word` except @story/@req/@supports) are treated as hard boundaries, finalizing any pending @story/@req annotation. This matches REQ-ANNOTATION-TERMINATION and REQ-JSDOC-BOUNDARY-DETECTION and is validated by the REQ-ANNOTATION-TERMINATION and REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES tests. - **Continuation Logic & Multiline Support**: Only non-tag lines are appended to the current pending annotation, and multi-line story values (split across lines) are preserved until a JSDoc tag is encountered, satisfying REQ-CONTINUATION-LOGIC and REQ-PRESERVE-MULTILINE. - **No False Positives**: The original bug scenario (req followed by @param/@returns) is explicitly tested and passes, confirming REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES. - **Backward Compatibility**: The entire existing valid-annotation-format test suite (for earlier stories and behaviors) continues to pass, showing no regressions. - **Documentation**: The rule documentation has an explicit "JSDoc coexistence" section describing the behavior and giving examples with story 022.0.
Given the concrete implementation changes, targeted tests tied to this story and its requirements, and a fully passing test run, the story is fully implemented and passes all specified criteria.
